vegas.source: nflverse schedules, Week-1 2026 closing lines (16/16 games - the only complete coverage window)

provenance.roles: inside-5 share and YMS are 2025-role priors and say so
provenance.proxy: routes = on-field membership on team dropbacks (participation 2025); counts pass-block snaps as routes

thresholds.note: qualification floors: WR/TE routes-proxy >= 150/100, QB 150+ attempts, RB with 2025 usage; proxies count pass-block snaps as routes (stated weakness), so thresholds are percentiles of OUR distribution, never PFF-unit imports

qb_gap.definition: top-12 QB season finishes 2016-2025 (n=120), rushing class = rush yds/g >= that season's p75 among 8+ game QBs; season TOTAL points under each scoring
